newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Record Argentine Sep flat steel output record.
newsitem.headline: Record Argentine Sep flat steel output record.

text.p: Argentine flat-rolled steel output was a record 120,000 tonnes in September, 37 percent more than in September 1995, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
September 1996 output was 20 percent more than in the same month in 1994, the Ministry said. It did not say how much output was in August this year.

"These rises in production will continue in the future," the Ministry said, adding that investment in the sector totaled "about $600 million over the last four years and will reach $1.3 billion in the next four years."
